correction_to_R122.what_R122_said: the sparse criterion has no resolution, written as a general statement

why_this_strengthens.identity_at_chance_on_both_criteria: in both_unseen, Synergy identity is 1.35 percent against 1.28 chance and dEMAX identity is 24.90 against 25.00, so two criteria correlating at only 0.20 agree
why_this_strengthens.both_criteria_agree_where_resolvable: in one_unseen and cell_unseen both criteria independently find no pathway gain
why_this_strengthens.so: the mechanism statement now rests on two largely independent criteria that agree

relation_to_the_frozen_claim.why_only_this_cell: in every other cell identity already sits 7 to 32 pp above chance, leaving no room to improve, so this is the only cell with headroom rather than the only cell that was reported

limits: two arms only; the random, permuted and dead-block controls were established in R126

retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI
